Aligners or braces, honestly

19 March 2026

There are cases where aligners are the wrong answer, and a practice that never says so is selling rather than treating.

If you are not sure which of the two applies to you, telephone the practice and describe it. We would rather spend four minutes on the telephone than have you spend a fortnight worrying.
